# ThinkorSwim — How to import trades from ThinkorSwim into TradeZella using the file upload method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/5829520-thinkorswim-how-to-import-trades-from-thinkorswim-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

With our straightforward guide, you can easily import your trades from ThinkorSwim into TradeZella. Follow these steps to ensure your trading data stays accurate and up-to-date.

💡 Pro Tip: Want to effortlessly import your trades into TradeZella?​Good news! TradeZella fully supports ThinkorSwim sync. Just head over to the Broker Sync page and follow the easy steps to connect your ThinkorSwim account and have your trade imported automatically into TradeZella. Happy trading!



The video is a bit outdated. If your TOS interface has changed, please follow the written instructions and screenshot provided below!



## Exporting trade data from ThinkorSwim into a file

- Launch your ThinkorSwim desktop application.

Launch your ThinkorSwim desktop application.

- Click on the "Monitor" tab located in the upper panel.

Click on the "Monitor" tab located in the upper panel.

- Select "Account Statement" from the dropdown menu.

Select "Account Statement" from the dropdown menu.

- Choose the date range for the trades you wish to export.

Choose the date range for the trades you wish to export.

- Select "Transactions" next to the Cash and Sweep Vehicle row.

Select "Transactions" next to the Cash and Sweep Vehicle row.

- Click on "Reset".

Click on "Reset".

- Select the "Trade History" row and click the gear icon to the right.

Select the "Trade History" row and click the gear icon to the right.

- Choose "Customize" and then click "Load Defaults" to ensure all required fields are included for export.

Choose "Customize" and then click "Load Defaults" to ensure all required fields are included for export.

- Click on the Actions menu located in the upper right header panel.

Click on the Actions menu located in the upper right header panel.

- Choose "Export to File".

Choose "Export to File".

- Save your file as a CSV (comma-separated value file).

Save your file as a CSV (comma-separated value file).



## Uploading the exported file into TradeZella

- Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

- On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

If you’re uploading trades to an existing account, simply click on the “Add Trades” button in the account field:

- On the Add New Account page, select ThinkorSwim as the broker and click Continue.

On the Add New Account page, select ThinkorSwim as the broker and click Continue.

- Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

- On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.

On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.



Importing your trades from ThinkorSwim into TradeZella is designed to be user-friendly and efficient. By following these steps, you'll maintain accurate trading records and gain insights to optimize your trading strategies. Happy trading!
